title: Swap two bytes
task: Swap the bytes at p and q, in the RAM, then stop: p gets the byte that was at q, and q the byte that was at p. Keep the labels p and q and their DB lines.
starter:
; swap -- practice exercise (MAVILERA, SAP-2)
; Swap the bytes at p and q.
; Hint: LDA and STA move one byte; keep one of them in B on the way.
        HLT           ; replace with your code

        ORG 0800H     ; the data, in the RAM
p:      DB 0
q:      DB 0
